composition_summary: Preserved the single user message unchanged. Drafted one class-22 pure-logic component pc-check-weighted-entries with name/description/content only. The body reads every raw field via inputs.get (never direct access), validates the list shape and each item's exact label/weight types and bounds before computing eligibility, and returns {ok, entries} with the original list only when valid and [] otherwise. It makes zero host calls, imports, I/O or coercions; booleans are rejected as integers; missing and null are distinguished; extra item fields fail closed. The list cardinality contract is 0..3 inclusive (empty valid), so a four-item list is rejected before any effect. This is an unapproved draft and a target typed-input interface; typed runner support and Q1/Q2 approval precede activation. No other proposal arrays were populated per the test scope.
adjusted_volatile_messages: Validate raw weighted entries, including an empty selection.

payload.name: pc-check-weighted-entries
payload.description: Pure-logic guard that validates a raw list of weighted entries and returns whether it is well-formed. The list must have 0..3 items inclusive (empty is valid). Each item must be a JSON object with exactly the fields label and weight: label is a string of length 1..8 inclusive, weight is an exact integer 0..1 inclusive, never a boolean or float. Missing, null, extra item fields or invalid shapes fail closed without exceptions. Returns {ok: boolean, entries: original list if valid else []}. No imports, host calls, I/O or type coercion.
